title: Fair Trivia
description: How to write and check trivia questions that are fair to everyone at the table: sourcing, difficulty and bias. Notes by Ahmed Moaz.
blurb: A trivia question is only fun if it is fair: checkable, unambiguous and not secretly about one country or one generation. These notes are about sourcing answers, judging difficulty and spotting the quiet biases in a quiz.
about: I am Ahmed Moaz. I build Boardit, a small site of free browser games, and its quiz game means writing and checking a lot of trivia questions.
This blog collects what I have learned about making trivia fair: where answers should come from, how to tell easy from hard, and which questions to throw away.
